scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,fe -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test-be && pnpm run test-fe
scripts.gen-api-types: pnpm --filter api run gen-openapi && pnpm --filter frontend run gen-types
